The world is a big place, and there are many interlocking processes for cycling essential elements. I teach science at the high school level. I'm not just battling lack of prior knowledge. I'm battling misinformation. Students come in fearing that we will run out of water, until we draw the water cycle on the board and they help draw it. Students are astounded when I tell them that they might well have carbon atoms in their bodies that were once part of a dinosaur, or water molecules that were once part of the Dead Sea. We trace the path of a carbon atom from carbon dioxide in the atmosphere through a Christmas tree, a Christmas cookie, their own digestion, blood, lungs, and back into the atmosphere to feed more trees. Once they open up and feel safe in a classroom, kids ask some very interesting questions.
